t: You're looking at the Swan Inn, a Grade II listed pub at 66 Bayswater Road, on the edge of Hyde Park. It dates back several centuries, and in former times it was a resting point for stage coaches heading toward London. Today it's run by Fuller's Brewery and is a popular haunt for tourists. Thomas Drury, an English government informer who lived from 1551 to 1603, died here, so the building has been a part of Londoners' lives for a very long time.
